scope: Actual short strict always-muted overte_hub admission, keyboard movement, native position and reconnect with opt-in bounded GPU timers. Browser density and gates remain unchanged.
claimLimit: Stock Firefox exposes no timer-query extension; this remains unsupported without changing privacy settings. Chromium GPU elapsed may include scheduling/driver idle and is not a fragment-only measurement. Firefox fails all fluidity gates; successful functional movement/reconnect does not satisfy that goal. The unrelated owned local native observer also consumes substantial CPU; causality requires a separately documented controlled cohort.
